shortDescription: Bloomberg Economics said the Reserve Bank of Australia will raise its key interest rate next week as energy prices surge and upside risks to inflation become clearer, according to Bloomberg.It also warned of a possible further increase in November.

title: GEOPOLITICS | Bloomberg Economics Sees RBA Rate Hike Next Week on Higher Energy Costs
